_meta.note: State-platform pass batch 1: re-source DL-0905 national-only party_platform cells to the state party platform (Principal ruling 2026-10-07)

1.note: kind: party_platform_state. The California Republican Party platform (the PDF linked from cagop.org/platform-bylaws), fetched 2026-10-07, does not take this position; its closest text is "We believe that the question of abortion is a matter that should be left to the people through their elected representatives". State platform governs where one is online (Principal ruling 2026-10-07), and the earlier answer (True) rested only on the national 2024 RNC platform, so the cell is left blank. The platform backs specific restrictions (partial-birth, sex-selection, taxpayer-funded abortion), not abolition.
